content.short: UNIGOX is a peer-to-peer platform for buying and selling USDT and USDC with local payment methods.
content.description: UNIGOX lets people buy and sell stablecoins such as USDT and USDC with local currencies through a peer-to-peer marketplace, routing each order to licensed partners to find the best exchange rate. It comes with its own wallet and mobile apps. Its site lists Unichain among supported networks, and Alchemy's Unichain directory includes it.
content.meta: UNIGOX is a P2P marketplace for buying and selling USDT and USDC with local currencies, supporting Unichain.
